items.name: Finsupp.weight_apply
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → M) [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (f : σ →₀ R), (Finsupp.weight w) f = f.sum fun i c => c • w i

items.name: Finsupp.weight_single
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → M) [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (s : σ) (r : R), (Finsupp.weight w) (Finsupp.single s r) = r • w s

items.name: Finsupp.sum_toMultiset
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] (f : α →₀ ℕ), (Finsupp.toMultiset f).sum = f.sum fun a n => n • a

items.name: finsum_eq_sum
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] (f : α → M) (hf : (Function.support f).Finite),
  ∑ᶠ (i : α), f i = ∑ i ∈ hf.toFinset, f i
